name: Lichoceves (Czechia)
description: Red field with a white cross whose horizontal arm runs the full length of the flag and whose vertical arm stops short of the edges, with a narrow blue stripe along the top and bottom.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 15 April 2010 (decision No. 75) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
